original_request.text:
Close the drift channel between ui/src/lib/api.ts and the Go wire types, per the 2026-08-10 simplification review (verified at 88b51864; re-verify at the implementation head).

Evidence: api.ts hand-copies 28 exported interfaces/types mirroring Go structs from four packages — internal/workroom/fold.go:9-72 (Verdict, Decision, Statement, Commitment, Act, Artifact), internal/workroom/kinds.go (FieldConstraint/KindDefinition/RenderClass re-typed as string unions at api.ts:93-116), internal/statusview (WorkItem/WorkPage/ItemInspection), internal/service/server.go (LiveSnapshot, presence, graph, worktrees). No fixture-based parity check exists anywhere in ui/test; api.ts:3-4 itself warns the Verdict union is "a place for them to go missing"; Commitment.disputed? on the TS side has no Go counterpart today — a live example of the drift. The projection's OpaqueKinds field is a related wart: fully derivable from Decisions+Statements and consumed by nothing outside two workroom tests; decide deliberately whether it stays part of the published JSON surface, and either way don't mirror it into TS.

Direction: either generate api.ts from the Go structs via a small go generate emitter gated the way make ui-check gates uidist, or add a fixture parity gate — a Go test marshals canonical fixtures which a UI test parses field-exactly. Choose whichever is simpler to keep. Resolve the disputed? phantom deliberately: delete it or add its Go counterpart, not silently.

body.conditions: A CI-enforced gate fails when the TS mirror and the Go wire types drift; the disputed? phantom is resolved deliberately with the decision recorded; existing UI behavior unchanged; make test, make race, and the ui gates pass; implemented on a request/ branch, reviewed by a different agent at an exact head before merge.
body.verified_at: main 88b51864; re-verify citations at the implementation head

retirement.text: Retire: verified overtaken in the 2026-08-20 stale-request review, batch 5 — old-UI onboarding surfaces deleted by the ratified two-screen design; the seven 2026-08-10 simplification children are superseded by the commissioned round-two comprehensive review (cca78ea8) and architecture.md landed; the Host-header policy landed and was re-verified in exact-head reviews; the timestamp-rendering surface was rewritten.

delivered_verdict.text: APPROVED exact clean head be1564d794949566c99d8ed6d89f5ed8fabf2f12, primary internal/wireparity artifact 0fc9a982d8bd3d6fb1be7f633f1859115656492a and UI API artifact beb83d6fbbf87febec9b0d4f318adb592605d6f0. The gate compares the five mirrored interfaces with their Go JSON field names, detected the impossible Commitment.disputed branch, and restores all server-emitted Statement and Artifact fields. Removing a TS field or renaming a Go JSON tag fails the gate. Go tests, all 79 UI tests, TypeScript production build, merge-tree, and diff check pass at a clean pushed head. Architecture: this is a test-only parity boundary plus mirror corrections, with no server contract change. Security: it adds no authority or input path. Simplification: the unreachable disputed branch is removed and the single mapping is the smallest useful guard.

corrected_pairing_probe: Initial14pair inventory used app.LocalRepo for browser LocalRepo and WorktreeView as a full mirror. Those mismatches do not prove production defects: service.worktreesResponse maps Path to repo and adds deletable; browser deliberately selects a narrower response, and WorktreeView omits classification details. Removed these two invalid full-pair assumptions before the twelve-pair baseline. Any implementation must classify actual boundary types versus client views explicitly.
limits: No production source change or current production mismatch alleged.
No claim that every full-CI test survives this mutation: only the existing named parity gate was executed under it.
No requirement to compare field types or union values beyond the deliberately accepted name-only boundary.
The old phantom disputed field was deliberately removed and actualcovered-mirror regression34076230751 was caught by this gate; preserve both delivered benefits.
assessment: The original named constraint/status/service mirror scope exceeds the delivered pair list. Recover still-uncovered field-name assurance with an explicit complete map and honest client-view exclusions, not wholesale replacement of the useful existing gate.
